title: StartServiceResponse
description: Response to a start service request, sent by the station to the app via BLE characteristic FFF4 (Notify). Confirms or rejects the service start.

result.description: Outcome of the start service request

sessionId.description: The session's identifier - the station's own for a pass it validated itself, the server's for a Partial-A or Partial-B authorization (profiles/offline/ble-session.md §1). Present when result is Accepted.

offlineTxId.description: Offline transaction identifier, present when result is Accepted

errorCode.description: The registry code of the refusal (07-errors.md §4.3). Present when result is Rejected.

errorText.description: The registry name of errorCode, in UPPER_SNAKE_CASE (07-errors.md §1.3). Present when result is Rejected.

details.description: Per-occurrence context of the refusal (07-errors.md §2.3). MAY be present when result is Rejected.
